method: Built-in image_gen; two-image targeted logo replacement
poster5: Retained original as it is the approved logo source.

edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / compositing.
Edit image 1, the TARGET POSTER. Image 2 is POSTER 5, the approved LOGO REFERENCE ONLY.
User request: remake this poster with THE LOGO FROM POSTER 5. This is a logo replacement; preserve the existing illustrated concept and composition.
Remove image 1's old HUMAN RESOURCES title and its old logo-specific icons, halos, rings, stamps or underline. Cleanly reconstruct only the background exposed by the replacement. Insert a faithful copy of the complete HUMAN RESOURCES logo from the TOP OF IMAGE 2: bold tightly stacked forward-leaning cream lettering, sharp coral-red offset shadow/edge, tiny navy saucer with MINT beam and little sparkle integrated into the A of HUMAN, long MINT swoosh underline beneath RESOURCES with upturned curved right end. Match the original reference's letter shapes, line proportions, slant, spacing, cream/coral/mint colours and integrated saucer-A motif. Both words must be spelled exactly "HUMAN RESOURCES". Do not invent a new title treatment, do not add a ring to O or any extra planet logo.
Fit the complete reference mark into the TARGET POSTER'S existing title area, preserving appropriate margin and original title placement; uniform scaling is allowed, no stretching or clipping. This is the SAME approved brand mark on a different poster, not a new typographic interpretation. If needed, use only a subtle dark navy edge/shadow for cream readability.
LOCK everything outside the old logo region: exact characters, expressions, proportions, poses, amount of cast, saucer position/design, scenery layout, lighting, colours, painterly low-poly materials, capture trails, props, crop and 2:3 portrait composition. Do not borrow any cow, farmer, weapons, stars, setting or composition from image 2. Output a single finished 1024x1536 portrait poster, no collage, no border, no added text.
TARGET-SPECIFIC PLACEMENT: Place replacement logo in the BOTTOM title area; preserve the huge floating cow, saucer and loose hat exactly.
